summary.text: Christian Manuel is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 22 since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia notes he was formerly known as Christian Hayes.

paragraphs.text: Christian Manuel was born in Nederland, Texas.
His career experience includes working for state Representative Joseph Deshotel as a case worker, district director and chief of staff.
Manuel succeeded Deshotel in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Human Services, Elections, and Local & Consent Calendars committees.
